P27, re-check instantiate packet 100 (the next 100 of 314 unruled), read whole with every concept quoted (_analysis/d3b_pq_P27_100a.txt and 100b.txt), under G1 and P27's reading as logged for packet 000. Four applications of that reading, stated before the rows and checked backwards on packet 000; none is an amendment. (1) A post by another room's member that proposes where this room's work should go is that room's talk (P08's terms, or P19's offer as host); it shows P27 only where the room takes it up (donaldglover c0031, carletonu c0006 and c0007). So falcons c0093, kilian c0066, FaroeIslands c0012 and evedreddit c0003 (a member advising the neighbour where to put the neighbour's work) do not show it. (2) A guest's change of its own spot in the host's thread is the guest's act; the host shows P19. So finland c0041 to c0050 do not show P27, and backwards AvoArmy R-AvoArmy-bf1e30c6192c-036 (a guest moves a Colorado avocado off the room's original after a member objects, c0097 and c0098) moves from specification to reject by a re-rule file. (3) A conversion of another room's work shows P27 only where the spot is weighed for something about it (luxembourg c0004 to c0006: a small Norwegian flag that already has red and white, a heart only 10 pixels to change, a nation that has two); a call to take a work with nothing said about the spot is P09's (katawashoujo c0016, as anarchocapitalism and bees in packet 000). (4) Where the concepts report the room's attempt being erased before it moves, the move is P10's (GabrielDropout c0036 and c0037); a crowded or contested start that did not take, with no erasure reported, is P27's restart of a misplaced start (hunterxhunter c0100 to c0112, kamenrider c0003 and c0004). Next: the rows and the re-rule file.

P27, re-check instantiate packet 200 (the next 100 of 214 unruled), read whole with every concept quoted (_analysis/d3b_pq_P27_200a.txt and 200b.txt), under G1 and P27's reading with the four applications logged at packet 100. One further note, stated before the rows, from G1's own words (the source theme and the cited concepts): where the concepts show a bare move or address, the source theme supplies the reason only where it names the act that concept performs. RelientK c0006 (the plan changed, going up, under t03 moving the logo when neighbours need the space) and riskofrain c0009 (start next to the commando already built, under t04 finding room without taking over creations) show P27; hyperlightdrifter c0053 and c0054 in packet 100 (a link and a move under t04 negotiating room and boundaries) stay rejected, since that theme names the talk and not the move. Kin named as such holds as in packet 000 (Russiaclan c0003, our Serbian brothers); an address beside kin not so named does not (ontario c0057). A move after the work was taken by the void or wiped out is P10's (paranatural c0006, PinkUnion's regrouping). Next: the rows.

P27, re-check instantiate packet 300 (the next 100 of 114 unruled), read whole with every concept quoted (_analysis/d3b_pq_P27_300a.txt and 300b.txt), under G1 and P27's reading with its applications. Two notes, stated before the rows, that apply the reading and change no ruling already written. (1) Application 1 needs the post to be evidently another room's (falcons, kilian and FaroeIslands named their side); where a suggestion with a reason about the place is posted in the room's thread and its writer is not shown to belong to another room, it counts as the room's own choosing (thailand c0133, UPenn c0017). (2) Shrinking the design is P27's where the reason is room or a neighbour or the void ahead (udub c0006, toolband c0143); shrinking for too few hands, or to a size the room can protect, is K02's judgment and P05's shrinking to hold (G11), as columbia in packet 000 (uruguay c0004 and c0018). A site weighed for a restart after the room's earlier work was wiped is P10's new spot (virginiatech, under t03 starting VT again when it gets wiped; twice c0042; seolhyun c0007), as clubpenguin c0058 in P27's absent reading; a move ahead of harm to the work that stands is P27's even after earlier losses (vinesauce c0067). Next: the rows.

P27, re-check restrict lines (all 40), read whole with every concept quoted (_analysis/d3b_pq_P27_restrict.txt), under G9 and G4a. Reading, stated before the rows. Of the 36 portable lines, most claim that P27's words Before any loss do not hold, because the room chooses, changes or holds a spot again after an earlier loss (iastate, lsu, loliconsunite, malta, msu, purdue, ucf, unturned, uva, vinesauce and others). P27's statement is read against P10's: After the work is erased or overrun, the room ... moves: a new spot, a smaller version, a fresh start. So the loss P27 comes before is the loss of the work being placed, as P27's absent reading set its edge. The restrict lines' condition is therefore held, and G9 reclassifies them by their concepts: a specification where the concepts show the room choosing, changing or holding the spot of the work that stands, before that work is lost, whatever the room lost earlier; an evidence limit (accept, none) where the concepts show only P10's new spot chosen right after the work was erased or overrun (hsv, iastate, lebanon, littlewitchacademia, mizzou, southpark, uiowa), or only addresses and moves without a reason (jerma985, nyu, spain). No line is a correction, so section 2 is not triggered for P27. The repeated reading is a wording question with no correction, mine to log under QD3-008: Before any loss reads as any loss in the room's history; a wording proposal (Before the work it places is lost) is held for D3c and written in notes-D3.md. Checked backwards: the instantiate line R-ethoslab-2ac3cccc7d35-023 (a backup proposed just in case while the Etho face still stands, c0042 to c0053) was rejected as P10's; P10 needs the work erased or overrun, and this face stands, so the line shows P27 (a spot chosen ahead of harm not yet come) and moves to specification by a re-rule file. The other P10 rejections stand: each follows the erasure or overrunning of the work that moves (virginiatech, twice, seolhyun, paranatural, PinkUnion, WisconsinBadgers, wales c0041, GabrielDropout). Next: the rows.

P27, re-check link (28), add-condition (14) and add-step (12) lines, read whole with every concept quoted (_analysis/d3b_pq_P27_link.txt, addcond.txt, addstep.txt), under G4, G4a, G5 and G9 and P27's reading as stated at its instantiate and restrict lines. Reading, stated before the rows. A link or added condition or step is a specification where a statement already holds it: P27's own (a neighbour asks and the room moves or reshapes; places weighed as contested; refusing to move once work is in; a backup spot chosen ahead of harm, as ethoslab), P08's terms (neighbours settle how works meet: 49ers lets part of its logo lie behind a neighbour's, and many links from a neighbour's request to a move), P16's help bartered for space (carletonu, malta), P19's host ruling on a guest's request for space (hongkong, latin), K02's judgment of too few hands (ssbpm, holding back a further move), and A10's mechanism, a room that judges it has too few hands to hold its spot stops fighting for it and moves (hatsune, necrodancer, rust, snsd, starlightstage). The before-loss scope conditions are held as at the restrict lines; where the concepts show only P10's fresh start after the work was erased (auburn, wales, PinkUnion) or a move without reason or order (columbia, thesimpsons, FederationPlace, xenoblade c0073), the line is a limit. One room's link or step that no statement holds is a particular: albania (a chat before a better place; P23 is a candidate and holds no line, G18), porterrobinson (fighting off griefing as the reason not to move), AcePlace (refusing to move on a successor canvas after hour 73, with no second room), hatsune's condition (no move until a ready spot) and necrodancer's step (stop upkeep at the old site as the move nears). finland, uruguay and virginiatech are rejected as at the instantiate lines (a guest's own move; another room's offer of a place with no uptake shown; P10's fresh start after a host's refusal). No line is a correction. Next: the rows.
